test_title: PYST 29 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A and B together can complete a job in 10 days. A alone can complete it in 15 days. How long will B take to complete the work alone?
solution:
**Given:**

A + B = 10 days

A alone = 15 days

**Formula Used:**

Total work = LCM of given times

Work rate = Work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 10 and 15 = 30

⇒ Total work = 30 units

⇒ Work done by (A + B) in 1 day = 30 ÷ 10 = 3

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = 30 ÷ 15 = 2

⇒ Work done by B in 1 day = 3 − 2 = 1

⇒ Time taken by B = 30 ÷ 1

⇒ Time taken by B = 30 days

**∴ The correct answer is 30 days.**
